comment: Scripted interaction for `openhost --app selectors` (SelectorApp.swift): every control on that screen is wired with addTarget(_:action:for:) / UITapGestureRecognizer(target:action:), never with a closure, so a visible change here proves selector dispatch ran. Window is 390x780; the nav bar is 64pt tall, so VC-view y + 64 = window y. Increment button center (104.5,230), Reset (285.5,230), the Counting Enabled switch (322.5,302), the gesture panel (195,410). Sequence: two Increment taps (counter 0->2, 'incrementTapped'), Reset (counter 2->0, 'resetTapped:'), switch off ('enabledChanged: off'), an Increment that is therefore ignored, switch back on, a panel tap ('handleTap:', +1) and a 0.7s panel press ('handleLongPress:', +10 at recognition, then the tap on lift, +1).
